role.title: Cloud Engineer
role.focus: Cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, IAM, automation and reliability
role.objective: Build, ship, test and maintain reliable production-grade systems in this specialization.

responsibilities.1: Design and implement cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, iam, automation and reliability.
responsibilities.2: Translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
responsibilities.3: Write clean, modular and testable code.
responsibilities.4: Work with databases, APIs and production infrastructure relevant to the role.
responsibilities.5: Debug failures using logs, metrics and systematic root-cause analysis.
responsibilities.6: Use Git and collaborative development practices.
responsibilities.7: Automate repetitive engineering and deployment workflows.
responsibilities.8: Apply security, reliability and performance best practices.
responsibilities.9: Document architecture, decisions and operational procedures.
responsibilities.10: Deploy solutions and monitor them in realistic environments.
responsibilities.11: Measure quality and improve systems based on evidence.
responsibilities.12: Collaborate with engineers, product stakeholders and data teams.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical engineering work.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with documented technical decisions and a deployed or reproducible implementation.

interview_questions.36: How do you manage cloud costs?
interview_questions.37: How do you secure cloud storage?
interview_questions.39: How do you debug network connectivity?
interview_questions.40: How do you troubleshoot a failed deployment?
interview_questions.41: How would you design a highly available API?
interview_questions.42: How would you design a private database architecture?
interview_questions.43: How would you deploy a web application?
interview_questions.44: How would you handle traffic spikes?
interview_questions.46: How would you design multi-zone infrastructure?
interview_questions.47: How do you monitor cloud health?
interview_questions.48: How do you prevent accidental public exposure?
interview_questions.50: How do you balance reliability, security and cost?

1.name: Highly Available Web Platform
1.description: Deploy a containerized web application across multiple zones with load balancing, managed database, private networking, autoscaling and monitoring.

2.name: Cloud Data Processing Service
2.description: Build an event-driven data processor using object storage, serverless/managed compute, queues, IAM and automated deployment.

3.name: Disaster Recovery Lab
3.description: Design and implement backup, restore, failover and recovery procedures for a multi-tier application with measurable RTO/RPO targets.
